name: Navigate the architectural rail without a sidebar
description: Verifies the primary navigation is a visible architectural rail and opens destinations instead of scrolling back through the landing journey.
steps: Select WORKS from the top rail
Select ORIGIN from the top rail
expected: WORKS opens as a separate in-verse room, VERSE returns to the landing journey, and ORIGIN remains a landing destination without a sidebar menu.

name: Open the Tools architecture and enter each tool chamber
description: Verifies Tools expands from the top rail and each tool has a meaningful in-verse destination.
steps: Open TOOLS from the top rail
expected: Production Suite opens inside Auralcraftverse, MixMind opens inside an Auralcraftverse tool chamber with its distinct UX, and Hush opens the embedded local restoration workspace within Auralcraftverse.

name: Discover deeper rooms through MORE
description: Verifies deeper architecture is discoverable from the same top navigation without duplicating it in the landing flow.
expected: The deeper rooms open as individual in-verse destinations and are not inserted into the initial landing scroll.

name: Use mobile architectural navigation
description: Verifies the navigation remains a horizontal architectural rail on mobile and dropdowns remain usable without a sidebar.
expected: The mobile rail remains visible, dropdowns open from their tabs, MixMind returns to the landing journey, and Archive opens as an in-verse room.

name: Keep shared environmental architecture while tool UX remains distinct
description: Verifies tool rooms retain the Auralcraftverse environmental shell while allowing each tool to keep a distinct interface language.
expected: Both tool destinations retain the shared Auralcraftverse environmental architecture and navigation, while MixMind and Hush use distinct tool-specific visual treatments.
